zh-CN.title: Chronelle 日程可见范围
items: 绑定后引导设置日程权限，也可从插件 Chronelle 再次进入
陌生人和好友默认可看忙闲，支持全局及类别组设置，好友权限不低于陌生人
精简绑定说明，收紧权限时及时撤销旧展示

en.title: Chronelle calendar visibility
items: Set visibility after binding or revisit it through the Chronelle plugin
Friends and strangers see availability by default, with global and per-group controls and a friend-access floor
Clearer binding copy and revocation of outdated displays when restricting access
